# A KEK vector for crypto/kek.
#
# kek <hex>: the KEK, read from seeded.New(7).
# keyid <text>: the key ID the record binds.
# record <hex>: the record the parent wraps, the KEK and then the SHA-256
#   digest of the key ID framed under DomainName.
# dek <hex>: a DEK.
# wrapped <hex>: the DEK wrapped by a Keeper over the KEK, as the salt
#   and then the envelope. The standard library chose its nonce, so the
#   vector is checked by unwrapping it.
kek 203a2a9af54cc7c7b5e364ab810f38fb88c333cde63a595588eedd647413b174

record 203a2a9af54cc7c7b5e364ab810f38fb88c333cde63a595588eedd647413b174fcedff0ab9bdfeab96787b1d3d35263795170573fbd50d6646a514d8b054ed26
dek 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
wrapped b144417dcb3493ad4e88b2c2eb7b5b40010b6165732d3235362d67636dab149e0ad3e5ed5a037c856675971a3840b99261190dcbe4317d3dc84c0f9ac1c11d13c01bc285e9766d8b7b38035d667f48d90e439cdfa9b4a733ca
